messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Hydrocodone and acetaminophen is a strong prescription combination pain medicine.
The medicine contains an opioid, hydrocodone.
The medicine also contains acetaminophen.
Acetaminophen is used to manage moderate to moderately severe pain.
The medicine is used when other pain treatments do not treat your pain well enough.
The medicine is also used when you cannot tolerate non-opioid pain medicines.
An opioid pain medicine that can put you at risk for overdose and death.
You are at risk for opioid addiction, abuse, and misuse that can lead to death.
This risk exists even if you take your dose correctly as prescribed.
Hydrocodone and acetaminophen is a Schedule II controlled substance.
All branded hydrocodone and acetaminophen (Norco, Vicodin, Lortab, Hycet, Lorcet, Verdrocet, Xodol, Zamicet) have been discontinued.
Generic hydrocodone and acetaminophen tablets and oral solution is still available.
Hydrocodone and acetaminophen first gained FDA approval on May 3, 1982.
Triplet: ["Hydrocodone and Acetaminophen", "fda approval date", "May 3, 1982"]

The relation 'fda approval date' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug received approval from the Food and Drug Administration on the date specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'fda approval year': The subject drug was approved by the US FDA in the year specified by the object entity.
B. 'has availability date': The subject drug has been available since the time period specified by the object entity.
C. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
D. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
E. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
